integrity: An analytic proof and an accompanying exact polynomial-identity checker; finite tests are supplemental and are not relied on for infinite-time conclusions.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the memoryless beta2=0 Riemannian RMSProp specialization with full gradient, fixed positive step, circle normalization retraction, objective -x1. The opposite critical stationary point is excluded, finite termination is exceptional in the critical rate law, and only symmetric period-two orbits are classified above threshold. Priority search is nonexhaustive; no external independent audit has been undertaken.
title: Sharp global phase transition and attracting two-cycles for memoryless Riemannian RMSProp on the circle
